# Velmora Aesthetics

> Physician-led luxury medical spa in Old Town Scottsdale, Arizona. Injectables, skin rejuvenation, laser and light, body contouring, IV therapy and medical weight loss, planned around natural-looking results. Medical Director: Dr. Elena Marsh, MD.

- Address: 7150 E Camelback Rd, Suite 240, Scottsdale, AZ 85251
- Phone: (480) 555-0142
- Hours: Mon to Tue 9 to 6, Wed to Thu 9 to 7, Fri 9 to 5, Sat 9 to 2, closed Sunday
- Book: https://velmora-aesthetics.com/book (free 20-minute virtual consultation or $50 in-person consultation credited toward treatment)
- Treatment quiz: https://velmora-aesthetics.com/quiz
